text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool helix-us-east-1: elevated error rate + tail latency. Severity: P1. Paging oncall alex.sre :rotating_light:

alex.sre: I’m on it. seeing repeated 5xx from helix pool leader, errors look like KV cache OOM on feeder. pulling logs now.

maria.ops: tagged — we’re cutting new metrics dashboard for this pool (latency, qps, per-tenant error-rate).

alex.sre: quick mitigation idea — isolate suspected tenant 'helix-tenant-42' from the pool and spill traffic to fallback pool (dedicated-fallback-1). Can someone confirm that tenant mapping and routing is ready?

raj.eng: I can do the routing change. plan: set tenant tag to route=dedicated-fallback-1, then scale helix pool +1 node, and clear KV caches for that tenant. Doing the routing in 2 steps to avoid flip-flop.

sam-product: Heads up — Helix (enterprise customer) will be impacted for a subset of requests. We need a short comms note for their CSM. @leila-support can you draft an outbound note? Keep it transparent but non-alarmist.

leila-support: on it. draft: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting a subset of requests for your dedicated pool. We're isolating impacted tenant traffic and expect partial service restoration within 30 min. We'll follow up with RCA and any credits if needed." Shall I send to their CSM now or wait until mitigation completes?

cody-ps: Please wait 10–15 min so we have a clear mitigation timeline. If rollback happens we should avoid premature comms.

alex.sre: Routing change executed: ```redwood route update --tenant helix-tenant-42 --pool dedicated-fallback-1 --txn-id 0x4f2a```

incident-bot: action logged by alex.sre (txn 0x4f2a). Auto-backup of routing table saved.

raj.eng: Scaling helix pool +1 initiated: ```kubectl patch ds/helix-pool -p '{"spec":{"replicas":6}}'``` waiting for node to join. Also running cache eviction for tenant 42: ```redwood cache evict --tenant helix-tenant-42 --scope kv```

alex.sre: After isolate + cache-evict, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 1.2% over 2 mins. tail latency moving down. Keeping observed window for 10 more mins.

maria.ops: Metrics captured: CPU spike on feeder pod helix-feeder-3 at time 12:07 UTC, OOM traces correlated with large batched requests from tenant-42. Recording for RCA.

jordan-eng-lead: Good mitigation. Next steps: continue monitoring, preserve logs for RCA, and propose bespoke follow-ups for Helix customer — options: 1) credit equivalent to downtime window, 2) dedicated config to limit batch size per-tenant, 3) postmortem + 72-hour patch with safer KV eviction. Thoughts?

sam-product: Option 2 + 3 are our preferred. Limit batch size is a good product-level mitigation; credits discussion if customer experienced measurable request loss.

leila-support: Draft to CSM updated: "Mitigation in place — we have isolated your tenant traffic and applied fixes. No data loss observed. We will share an RCA within 48 hours and propose remediation steps including per-tenant batching limits."
